name: AI Deepfake Scandal
description: A viral video shows a public figure making shocking statements. It may be real, or it may be a deepfake.

responses.label: Denounce the Statement
responses.description: Publicly condemn the statement as harmful.

responses.label: Verify Authenticity First
responses.description: Wait for forensic verification before taking action.

responses.label: Take Legal Action
responses.description: Pursue legal remedies against the content creator.
